description: table role via epub:type="table"/"table-row"/"table-cell" on neutral <div> elements — the only encoding of table previously untested, despite extensive native/ARIA table coverage. epub:type has no columnheader/rowheader equivalent at all (only table/table-row/table-cell are mapped in epubTypeRoles), so this is necessarily a header-less data grid, same shape as table-no-headers
